body:
I would like to use PhotoGIMP which is custom version of GIMP as a external editor. I can use it with RawTherapee but ART doesn't recognize it. I tried to use the custom command from RawTherapee but it still doesn't work and I cant find any documentation about the custom commands on ART.

The Rawtherapee's custom command:
`/usr/bin/flatpak run --branch=stable --arch=x86_64 --command=gimp-3.0 --file-forwarding org.gimp.GIMP @@u %U @@`
title: Using external editor
